description: Decompose an approved OpenSpec design into tasks.md

change_name.description: The name of the OpenSpec change folder

steps.title: Create tasks.md stub
steps.command:
echo '# Tasks for {{change_name}}

- [ ] Task 1: Description
  - Validation: specific test or command
' > openspec/changes/{{change_name}}/tasks.md

steps.title: Agent Decomposition Task
steps.description: Read design.md for {{change_name}} and break it down into actionable `<30m` tasks in tasks.md.
